title: API Gateway Connection Pool Exhaustion
description: API Gateway became unresponsive due to connection pool exhaustion after a spike in traffic. Thread pools were increased and gateway was restarted.
actionItems: Increase default HikariCP connection pool limit to 100
Implement client-side rate limiting on public routes

title: Stripe Webhook Verification Failures
description: Incoming Stripe payment webhooks failed signature checks. Rollback of billing deployment DEP-8891 resolved the validation mismatches.
actionItems: Add Stripe signature key verification checks to pre-deployment integration tests
Set up dynamic configuration toggle for webhook validation bypass in emergencies

title: ScyllaDB Read Latency Spike
description: Read latencies spiked above 150ms on the user sessions table. Query indexing was optimized and read repair was disabled temporarily.
actionItems: Add composite partition key to user_sessions table
Update alert rules to trigger at 100ms average read latency

title: WebSocket Connection Drops
description: Subscribers on client dashboard experienced disconnection cascades. Redis Pub/Sub buffer limits were adjusted.
actionItems: Scale Redis instance horizontally to 3 shards
Implement exponential backoff reconnect logic in frontend client

title: Auth Token Cache Invalidation Failure
description: Active session tokens fail to invalidate upon user logout due to Redis cluster failover delay. Investigating write-through replication lag.
actionItems: Deploy Redis cluster topology sync updates
